title: Whale wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='water' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#7fd4ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#3aa8e0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#6ec6ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#3287c9'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- whale body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='58' rx='34' ry='20' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <!-- belly lighter shade -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='66' rx='26' ry='10' fill='#b9e6ff'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M80 54 Q92 42 96 34 Q88 44 84 52 Q88 50 94 50 Q88 54 84 60 Q88 64 96 66 Q90 62 82 62 Z' fill='#3287c9'/>
  <!-- flipper -->
  <path d='M40 66 Q36 80 46 78 Q50 72 48 66 Z' fill='#2a76b3'/>

  <!-- head hump / upper head -->
  <path d='M14 58 Q10 44 24 40 Q36 36 44 46 L44 56 Z' fill='#5db8f0'/>

  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M22 66 Q30 74 42 68' fill='none' stroke='#1c5e94' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- eye spot (white sclera behind shades, small) -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='50' r='7' fill='#eaf8ff'/>

  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x='20' y='44' width='14' height='11' rx='3' fill='#2d2d6e'/>
  <rect x='36' y='44' width='14' height='11' rx='3' fill='#2d2d6e'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='33' y='47' width='4' height='3' fill='#2d2d6e'/>
  <!-- arm to tail side -->
  <rect x='49' y='46' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#2d2d6e'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <rect x='22' y='46' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#9fdcff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <rect x='38' y='46' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#9fdcff' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- blowhole water spout -->
  <path d='M26 34 Q24 26 28 22 M26 34 Q28 26 34 24 M26 34 Q20 28 18 24' fill='none' stroke='#bff0ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- water spray spots -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='20' r='2' fill='#d8f7ff'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='22' r='1.6' fill='#d8f7ff'/>
</svg>
